questions.question:
Durante el día, con tiempo claro, ¿cuándo es obligatorio encender la luz corta?
During the day, in clear weather, when is it compulsory to switch on lowbeam lights?

answers.text:
Las de corto alcance y las de posición.
The low beam and the position lamps.

Ninguna.
None.

Solo las de posición, porque se ve bien.
Only the position lamps, because you can see clearly.

questions.help: 8 Headlights - Low beam / dipped beam / short range 8.2 Use of the low beam headlightsAll motor vehicles and mopeds must use the low beam headlights (together with the position lights) when travelling:Between the hours of sunset and sunrise:- Inside and outside towns and cities on roads that are sufficiently illuminated.- On roads inside town and cities that are insufficiently illuminated.(Página 101 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
Si está amaneciendo y aún no ha salido el sol, ¿qué luces debe llevar encendidas en su turismo?
If you are driving at dawn and the sun has not yet risen, which lights should you have on?

answers.text:
Al circular por un carril para VAO.
When driving in a high-occupancy vehicle lane.

Cuando llueve.
When it is raining.

Al circular por un carril reversible.
When driving in a reversible lane.

questions.help: 8 Headlights - Low beam / dipped beam / short range     8.2 Use of the low beam headlightsAll motor vehicles and mopeds must use the low beam headlights (together with the position lights) when travelling:Any hour of the day, when driving:- On any lane of a road in which an additional circumstantial lane has been enabled.- In a lane that has been enabled in a contrary direction to normal, that is, the use is exclusively reserved for certain users or due to exceptional circumstances, the direction for use has been changed.- On the lane for the normal driving direction, adjacent to the one enabled for driving in the opposite direction than normal.- In a reversible lane.(Página 101 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
¿Cuándo es obligatorio utilizar el alumbrado de corto alcance durante el día?
When is it compulsory to use low-beam headlights during daylight hours?
